text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville this Sunday to face the Jaguars at 1 PM ET, armed with a defensive scheme built around exploiting Cover-6 and offensive plays centered on "X" concepts, though they'll need to tighten up their clock management after two straight weeks of questionable late-halftime decisions. The roster has undergone some shuffling ahead of the matchup: Mike Onwenu's broken right ankle will reshape the offensive line, rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice as a positive sign for his availability, and the team promoted linebacker Jose Ramirez to the 53-man roster from the practice squad while placing safety Dell Pettus on injured reserve and signing linebacker Benton Whitley to the practice squad. While the offense hasn't quite recaptured the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run, the defense proved itself formidable in a dominant 20-3 victory over Pittsburgh, with TreVeyon Henderson punching in a touchdown as the Patriots' strong defensive performance compensated for offensive struggles.
